    (hf : AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval f a b) (hg : LipschitzOnWith K g (uIcc a b))
    (hmaps : MapsTo f (uIcc a b) (uIcc a b)) :

  intro ε hε

    _ = (K : ℝ) * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range E.1, dist (f (E.2 i).1) (f (E.2 i).2) := by rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ ≤ (K : ℝ) * (ε / (K + 1)) := by gcongr; exact (h E hE hlen).le
    _ < ((K : ℝ) + 1) * (ε / (K + 1)) := by gcongr; linarith
